name: Han Swing Bridge
kicker: The Han bridge that turns for ships
summary: Stand on the bank and watch the Han swing bridge turn for ships. It opened on 29 March 2000, runs 487.7 meters from Le Duan to Pham Van Dong, and the middle span turns about 90 degrees. The tourism page sets visitors from 23:00 to midnight on Saturday and Sunday, and also says about 23:00 every night. The city portal says about 01:00, back about 04:00. Watching from the bank is free.
getThere: The west end is the Le Duan–Tran Phu junction. Walk from a river hotel. Minutes from My Khe are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The swing bridge lit at night, seen from the bank

notice.title: The turn is published three ways
notice.body: The tourism page gives Saturday and Sunday, 23:00 to midnight, for visitors, and also says the span turns about 23:00 every night for ships. A later itinerary page names only the weekend. The city portal says about 01:00, back about 04:00, and that large boats rarely pass now so a turn is often maintenance. Check that night.

body: Come late and stand on the bank. The bridge joins Le Duan in Hai Chau to Pham Van Dong in Son Tra, at the Le Duan–Tran Phu junction. The city portal says work started on 2 September 1998 and the bridge opened on 29 March 2000. It gives the length as 487.7 meters, the width as 12.9 meters, 11 spans, and two cable-stayed spans totaling 122.7 meters. The tourism page had already given the length, the width, and the 11 spans.

The clocks do not agree. The tourism page tells visitors the bridge turns from 23:00 to midnight on Saturday and Sunday, and also says that every night, at about 23:00, the middle span turns 90 degrees so ships can pass and is back by about midnight. A later key-times page names only the Saturday and Sunday turn, at about 23:00. The city portal says the middle turns about 01:00 and is back about 04:00, and that large boats rarely pass now, so a turn is often maintenance. Do not treat a weeknight as guaranteed, and do not drop the 23:00 lines.
The photograph is the bridge lit at night. It does not show the span in the middle of a turn. There is no ticket for watching from the bank.

figures.caption: The deck and the sail-shaped pylon, in daylight
figures.alt: Motorbikes crossing the Han swing bridge, with the blue pylon over the river

gettingThere: The published address is the Le Duan–Tran Phu junction. From a hotel on Bach Dang, walk to that end. From My Khe, cross the river by Grab. The city page does not print those minutes, so they stay check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the river
legs.body: Walk to the Le Duan–Tran Phu junction. The page does not print a minute count.

legs.heading: From My Khe
legs.body: By Grab across the river. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Tourism page: 23:00 to midnight on Saturday and Sunday for visitors, and about 23:00 every night for ships, back by about midnight. City portal: about 01:00, back about 04:00, often for maintenance. Check that night.
closed: No weekly closing day is published. The disagreement is which nights it turns.
